issues.legal_issue: A statutory time limit governing applications for court references applies to requests for references under a land-acquisition enactment that adopts the general reference procedure, even before a reference is made.
material_facts: Land was acquired and compensation was awarded.
The claimant accepted the compensation under protest and later applied for a reference seeking a larger amount.
The application was made after the time limit applicable under the general land-acquisition reference procedure.
The authority rejected the application as out of time, and the High Court declined to interfere.
issues.conclusion: The reference provisions adopted by the land-acquisition enactment include the limitation period for applying for a reference. The application was barred by time, so the appeal was dismissed; it was unnecessary to decide whether the application had been made within a reasonable time.
issues.legal_principle: Section 8(2) of the West Bengal Land (Requisition and Acquisition) Act, 1948, read with section 18(2) of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, applies the prescribed limitation period to an application seeking a reference. The phrase applying the general Act in respect of a reference includes a reference intended, proposed, or asked to be made, not merely proceedings after the reference is made. The mandatory duty to refer under section 8(1) does not displace that limitation, just as the corresponding duty under section 18(1) is subject to section 18(2). The amended section 8(2), which expressly refers to section 18(2), supports this construction. The earlier Calcutta High Court decision in Kajori Lal Agarwal v. Union of India, 59 C.W.N. 936, was overruled.

predicates.land_acquisition_compensation_reference_: A person aggrieved by a compensation award in a land-acquisition matter asks the responsible authority to refer the dispute to a court.
predicates.incorporated_reference_procedure: The enactment governing the acquisition adopts the general procedure for references to a court, including rules governing requests for a reference.
predicates.request_after_deadline: The person submits the request after the applicable time limit has expired.

issues.definition: When a person requests a court reference about a land-acquisition compensation award under an enactment adopting the general reference procedure, and the request is submitted after the applicable deadline, the reference application is time-barred.
